features: Customer welcome/subtitle, online/offline pills, desktop navigation and wallet glyphs use readable semantic theme colors; owner can customize each light/dark palette.

Customer connection switch clips its knob within the track and submits via authenticated CSRF-protected AJAX. It waits for confirmed state and exposes pending node synchronization without claiming the connection is already enforced.
Account-menu sign-out stays on one row; avatar picker opens from the plus button, includes own-photo upload and a real save button.

Support actions share high-contrast pill controls. The Telegram community poster, local three-dimensional logo, floating small badge and channel/group/admin actions move from the account overview to support.

Client navigation keeps the dock and background canvas mounted, fetches fresh authenticated account views, handles history and selected-tab transitions, uses a strict same-account route allowlist and pins local program bytes; response inline scripts are never evaluated.
Mobile dock bottom spacing increases; notification counts use small corner badges rather than covering glyphs.
Known product notification messages are localized at read time in the selected customer/admin language. Single-item dismissal is CSRF-protected and isolated to the account or administrator.
Theme studio is linked inside General settings. Top toolbar/tab controls share colors, selected state, spacing and wrapping across management pages.
Avatar glow supports custom color, intensity, speed and static/breathe/RGB/orbit effects, with reduced-motion handling. Existing theme settings migrate without losing customized values.
Wallet renewal payment uses readable title/balance and a distinct payment button; plan cards are more compact, offer badges share a row, and gifts have stronger contrast near the price.
Avatar character artwork and VPN/session enforcement core remain unchanged.

validation.source: Python/Jinja/CSS/Bash and installer checks, 44 EN/FA server-rendered page checks; 50 JavaScript programs parse; 49 local AJAX program pins.
validation.css: Authored cascade at 390/1200px in both modes, including customer/admin switch geometry, avatar-themed wallet payment contrast, mobile dock and toolbar/layout checks.
validation.navigation: VM checks verify persistent dock/canvas, same-account route boundaries, authenticated response verification, history ordering, locale reinitialization and preservation of the prior view on failure.
validation.notifications: Customer/admin per-item dismissal, ownership and CSRF boundaries; generated message localization and preservation of custom content.
validation.payments: Existing wallet renewal, balance, idempotency and post-commit failure handling tests pass.

limitations: Actual browser/iPhone visual rendering and installation on a VPS remain unverified; server/DOM/CSS and VM checks do not replace those checks.
Custom notification content and technical node error details are preserved rather than machine-translated.
GitHub publication is not performed by this archive.
